form.name: Name
form.details_help: Shown on the About page, and the first member on the home page.
form.image_section_help: A square head-and-shoulders photo works best. The description for screen readers is written automatically from the name.
form.social_links_help: Only real, working profiles. Leave empty to show none.

delete.description: This will permanently delete the testimonial. This action cannot be undone.

form.name: Name
form.avatar_help: JPG, PNG or WebP. Max 2MB. Shown as circular avatar.
form.details_help: Only publish words a real client has agreed to have quoted.

delete.title: Delete FAQ?
delete.description: This will permanently delete the FAQ. This action cannot be undone.

form.details_help: Write the question the way a client would ask it.
form.question: Question
form.placement_help: General questions show on the home page and the FAQ page. A question assigned to a service also shows on that service page.
form.service_help: Leave as General if it applies to the whole firm.

delete.title: Delete Service?
delete.description: This will permanently delete the service. This action cannot be undone.

form.title: Title
form.slug_help: The end of the page address, for example income-tax. Letters, numbers and dashes only.
form.description_placeholder: Main description shown on the Services page...
form.image_help: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB. Resized and converted to WebP automatically.
form.icon_svg_help: Paste a trusted SVG string. This is rendered on the public page.
form.details_help: Name, address and the text shown on the website.
form.short_description_help: One or two lines. Shown on service cards and under the page title.
form.description_help: The main paragraph on the service page.
form.features_help: What the service covers. The first three also appear on the service card.
form.steps_help: The steps a client goes through. Shown as a numbered list on the service page. Leave empty to hide.
form.documents_help: What the client should bring or send. Leave empty to hide.
form.timeline_help: How long this usually takes. Leave empty to hide.
form.fees_help: How fees are set for this service. Only state amounts you are happy to publish. Leave empty to hide.
form.media_help: The picture and icon shown for this service.
form.settings_help: Whether the service is shown, and where it sits in the list.
form.active_help: Hidden services do not appear anywhere on the website.

datatable.try_adjusting: Try adjusting your filters or create a new entry.

site_settings.title: Site Settings
site_settings.subtitle: Contact details and links shown across the public website.

contact.title: Contact
contact.help: Shown in the header, footer and contact page. Leave a field empty to hide it.

social.title: Social links
social.help: An icon is shown only for links that are filled in.

images.title: Page images
images.help: The large picture at the top of each page. Uploads are resized and converted to WebP automatically. Use a landscape picture at least 1280 pixels wide.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp number
whatsapp.help: Include the country code. Used for the WhatsApp buttons.

enquiry_email.label: Enquiry notification email
enquiry_email.help: New enquiries from the website are emailed here. Not shown to visitors.

maps_url.label: Google Maps link
maps_url.help: The share link for the office location.

office_hours.label: Office hours
office_hours.help: For example: Saturday to Thursday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

response_time.label: Response time
response_time.help: For example: within one working day. Shown next to the enquiry form.

whatsapp_message.label: WhatsApp template message
whatsapp_message.help: Already typed for the visitor when they tap a WhatsApp button. Leave empty to open a blank chat.

map_latitude.label: Map latitude
map_latitude.help: Optional. With longitude, pins the map on the contact page exactly. In Google Maps, right-click the office and copy the two numbers.

map_longitude.label: Map longitude
map_longitude.help: Optional. If both are empty the map searches for the office address instead.

enquiries.subtitle: Messages sent through the website form.

detail.title: Enquiry
detail.reply_help: WhatsApp and email open with a greeting already written. Change the status once you have replied.
detail.notes_help: Only staff can see these. Record calls, promises and next steps.
detail.note_placeholder: What was said, or what happens next...

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: What needs attention on the website.

recent.title: Recent enquiries
recent.empty: No enquiries yet. They appear here when someone uses the website form.

enquiry_email.label: Enquiry notification email
enquiry_email.help: Set the address that receives new enquiries.

mail.label: Email sending
mail.help: Mail is not configured on the server, so enquiry emails are not sent. Ask your developer to add SMTP details.

maps_url.label: Google Maps link
maps_url.help: Add it so visitors can open directions to the office.

response_time.label: Response time
response_time.help: Tell visitors how soon you reply, for example within one working day.

hero_images.label: Page images
hero_images.help: Upload pictures for the home, services and about pages.

testimonials.label: Client testimonials
testimonials.help: Add at least one real testimonial to show the section on the home page.

image_field.drop_here: Drag a picture here, or choose a file.
image_field.guidance: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB. Use a picture at least 1280 pixels wide; it is resized and converted automatically.
image_field.wrong_type: That file is not a JPG, PNG or WebP picture.
image_field.too_large: That picture is larger than 8 MB. Choose a smaller one.
image_field.alt_help: Read aloud to visitors who cannot see the picture. Say what it shows in a few words.
image_field.alt_required: Describe the picture for visitors who cannot see it.
image_field.crop_help: Drag to choose the part of the picture to keep.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: The privacy page of the public website.
privacy.draft_text: This text was drafted from how the website works. It has not been checked by a lawyer. It is not shown on the website, and no link to it appears, until you tick the box below and save.
privacy.published_text: The policy is live at /privacy and linked from the footer and the enquiry form.
privacy.policy_help: Start a line with ## for a heading and with - for a list item. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
privacy.publish: A lawyer has reviewed this policy. Publish it on the website.
privacy.publish_help: Untick to take the page down again.
